about: Accessible WC modelled as a generic assembly in a 1500 x 2200 room (back wall y = 0, side wall x = -750, room walls and door are not part of the family; the 1700 type only moves the opposite wall, so both types share the fittings): WC with contrasting seat and raised lid, cistern, flush lever on the transfer side, hinged drop-down rail with roll holder, side-wall horizontal and vertical rails, corner hand-rinse basin with mixer, mirror, pull cord with two bangles, alarm reset unit, towel dispenser, sanitary bin; turning circle on Clearance Accessibility.
